title: The workbench in the shop: buy it, set it down, tap it, and page between its five plates
tier_reason: Game code behind both suites and the replay round-trip; git reverts it. The design is the CEO's, ruled whole as Q-101.
ask: WI-2 in docs/V0_2_2_PLAN.md: a workbench row in the catalogue and the shop's stock list, set down through place on a yard tile as a tall blocking object, opened by a tap through a special-object row without a verb, and the full-screen five-plate shell as a fifth mode of the menus with five page stubs.
source_message: CEO, 2026-09-10: build the training workbench as v0.2.2 (Q-101), sim side first.
result: Landed on main (ccd123a). The workbench row and shop entry, set down through place as a tall blocking object, opened by a tap with no verb, the workbench mode of the menus, the five-plate shell with portrait strip, name, day and close card, five page stubs, the shared pip and action-glyph drawing, and a capture tool that keeps its autosave out of the shared user directory. test_workbench_place (30) and the opens-from-the-yard scenario (28). Chief of staff verified on a clean checkout: unit 2538, integration 717, gateway clean.
